notes.title: Update V5.1
notes.content:
Lots of feedback on the difficulty of the first level of electronic missions
Prof will now teach you the main workings.

notes.title: OTW Demo
notes.content:
Added shortcut to tutorial videos to learn more about the electric simulator.
Fixed activity tree.
Fixed music level being too loud in classes
Minor fixes

notes.title: OnTheWire
notes.content:
Main changes:

- Ability to switch to windowed mode.

- Video recording option in the electronic simulator.
Functionality a little resource intensive, will be improved, but in the meantime, do not make too long videos.

- Added first level of assisted tabletop assignment:
Addition in columns (The level is a bit uncluttered, this will of course be improved)

notes.title: OnTheWire Demo
notes.content:
Updates done in this version 2.6

1- New design of the Campus Buildings to get them more "Cartoon"
2- Add a Loading progress bar between different scenes
3- Bug correction First mecanic level
4- A picture of the last circuit is taken if it has failed. The player can mail Prof with it to get help

Next update priority

1- Replace the actual Activity tree to allow user to see is progress in all the 1st season activity
2- Add fist math level "Integers"
3- Add 1st Test level with "Basic operations in column"

Still to do:

- Add the "Story of Life" Building
- Add the "BreadBoard" Building
- Implement the first "time travel" with the ballon
- Interactivity with AngeloStudio internet Site
- Add several specail activities, puzzles in the Campus
- Improve terrain quality and design

I hope to open this free demo to the whole Steam community soon and get good returns to invest in a full developer and graphic designer team to build the first full OTW season.

Angelo.

notes.title: OTW Demo
notes.content:
A demo of the game has been opened to a couple of players for the moment.
I will open it to more players as soon as I receive positive reviews from the actual testers.

Modifications done on the actual live 2.41 version

1- The player can now select the screen resolution and quality according is computer performance.
2- Several windows have been modified to improve the player interface understanding.
3- First version of Activity tree have been implemented to see all the possibilites of the first season of OTW. (will be improved soon)
4- First level of Science course is now available in the demo.
5- Minor bugs correction

Still to do

- Redesign Campus buildings to get them more detailed and beautiful and with a name being translatable
- Add  the "Story of Life" Building
- Add the "Experience" Building
- Add the "BreadBoard" Building
- Implement the first "time travel" with the ballon 
- Interactivity with AngeloStudio internet Site
- Add several specail activities, puzzles in the Campus
- Improve terrain quality and design

I hope to open this free demo to the whole Steam community in a few weeks and get good returns to invest in a full developer and graphic designer team to build the first full OTW season.

Angelo.
